1.w: A Song of the Ascents. Of David. Behold, how good and how pleasant [is] the dwelling of brothers even together!

2.w: [It is] good like oil upon the head, running down upon the beard, the beard of Aaron, which is running down upon the mouth of his garments;

3.w: [or] like the dew of Hermon, which is coming down upon the mountains of Zion. For there YHWH commanded the blessing—life even to forever!
